• Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright.

• Build and enhance automation frameworks using TypeScript or JavaScript.

• Automate UI, functional, regression, and end-to-end test scenarios.

• Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and QA teams to understand requirements and define test strategies.

• Execute automated test suites and analyze test results.

• Report, track, and verify defects using defect management tools.

• Integrate automation suites with CI/CD pipelines.

• Improve test coverage and reduce manual testing efforts.

• Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.

• 4–9years of experience in Software Testing and Test Automation.

• Strong hands-on experience with Playwright.

• Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript.

• Experience with API testing using Postman or REST Assured.

• Knowledge of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

• Experience with Git or other version control systems.

• Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.

• Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.

• Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
